purpose: Design of the agent-review backend SKILL, which only performs availability checks on the read-only reviewer custom Agent while /forge:review launches the agent and exchanges findings.
summary: Overview: agent-review is a backend SKILL whose sole duty is the availability check; it holds no sessions, history, or DB records
Architecture: the review body checks availability, launches reviewer fresh each round, and passes review_id and round_number
Components and responsibilities of the agent-review SKILL, the reviewer Agent, and the /forge:review body
Agent definition constraints: no Write/Edit/Agent/Skill tools, Read/Grep/Glob/Bash allowed, plan permission mode, advisor tool forbidden
Read-only git query whitelist (status, diff, show, log, merge-base, rev-parse, ls-files) and a blacklist of mutating operations
Availability check with five conditions: definition file, tools, model and permission mode, role prohibitions, and presence of scripts and documents
Result format: available flag, missing entries with axis, detail and remedy, and retains_context always false
State and resource policy: no agent session, transcript, history, DB record, daemon process, or resource to release
Test design covering availability check, retains_context declaration, read-only constraints, and non-persistence
tasks: Implementing or modifying the agent-review backend SKILL
Editing the reviewer custom Agent definition and its tool constraints
Implementing the availability check logic and its missing-entry reporting
Reviewing design documents related to the review backend
Writing tests for the availability check and read-only constraints
Changing review backend selection or the retains_context declaration
title: DES-072 agent-review バックエンド設計
